subject: Decision Making
title: Placebo Ethics
description: A fast breakdown of Placebo Ethics for builders.

hook.text: Placebos work. Sugar pills relieve pain in 30 percent of patients. But using them means lying.

buildup.text: Clinical trials require a placebo group. Some patients receive no real treatment.

discovery.text: The Helsinki Declaration says placebos are unethical when effective treatment exists.

twist.text: Open-label placebos work too. Telling patients it is a placebo still reduces symptoms. Honesty and healing can coexist.

climax.text: Placebo ethics reveal the tension between scientific rigor and individual patient care. Knowledge needs sacrifice.

punchline.text: Lie and heal, or be honest and lose the effect? Placebos challenge truth itself.

quiz.question: When are placebos considered unethical in clinical trials?
options: When an effective treatment already exists and is being withheld
